answer_1.quote: We finetune Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct on AutoSDT-5K and obtain AutoSDT-Coder, a series of LLMs with improved coding capabilities for data-driven discovery. We evaluate AutoSDT-Coder on two challenging data-driven discovery benchmarks, ScienceAgentBench and DiscoveryBench.
answer_1.outputs: code solutions for data-driven scientific discovery tasks

answer_2.quote: For ScienceAgentBench, we report (1) Success Rate (SR): a binary metric that examines whether a program output meets the human-annotated success criteria for each task goal and (2) Valid Execution Rate (VER): a binary metric which checks if the program can execute without errors. In DiscoveryBench, we evaluate the generated hypotheses using Hypothesis Matching Score (HMS).

answer_3.quote: In DiscoveryBench, we evaluate the generated hypotheses against gold hypotheses using Hypothesis Matching Score (HMS), which breaks them down into sub-hypotheses with GPT-4o to calculate semantic matches.

answer_4.quote: We engage 9 subject matter experts to examine a subset of 256 tasks. The experts report that 93% of the instructions are scientifically authentic and 92.2% of the generated programs are deemed correct solutions, confirming the high quality of AutoSDT-5K.
answer_4.guideline: Experts answered a questionnaire evaluating task instruction validity, scientific authenticity, clarity, and code solution correctness.
